profile.headline: Software Engineer @ ChargeOver | JavaScript, HTML, PHP
profile.summary:
Graduated with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Minnesota and currently contributing as a Software Developer at ChargeOver. Proficient in JavaScript, HTML, and PHP, with a focus on enhancing subscription billing services.  

At ChargeOver, collaborated on projects including the development of a user role tracking system, subscription cancellation features, and UI overhauls impacting the entire customer base. Dedicated to improving workflows and customer experience through innovative solutions and effective team collaboration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered a user role tracking system capturing 2,000+ data points by integrating backend services with third-party CRM, communication, and product analytics platforms.
- Captured structured churn feedback from 100% of canceling users by building and launching an in-app cancellation workflow.
- Unified 100% of the customer base onto a single, modernized subscriptions UI by coordinating cross-functional efforts and shipping targeted bug fixes and UI improvements throughout the migration.
- Implemented future price scheduling, enabling 500+ customer-scheduled billing changes per month and developing real-time data visualizations to monitor transaction accuracy and system performance.
- Reduced engineering response times to under 24 hours by architecting a streamlined workflow between customer support and engineering task management systems.
- Led a cross-functional team to re-architect the core refund engine, improving financial data integrity and enabling more granular transaction adjustments.
- Delivered 100+ tailored invoice and quote PDF templates.
- Supported junior engineer development through code reviews and technical guidance.

positions.title: Hardware Technician
positions.description:
- Provided technical support to employees, logging issues accurately and escalating when necessary.
- Operated telecommunication tracking software efficiently and accurately to document calls.
- Delivered professional customer service by promptly answering calls, speaking clearly, offering solutions and additional assistance, and ensuring understanding.

positions.title: English Language Assistant
positions.description:
- Accumulated in-class teaching experience for ESO and Bachillerato.
- Performed duties including classroom management, lesson planning, teaching English as a foreign language and Cambridge Examinations.
- Tutored students in a one-on-one setting with the purpose of internalizing classroom knowledge and improving English fluency.
positions.insights: Communication and Teaching English as a Foreign Language

positions.title: Access Assistant
positions.description:
- Worked to remove barriers for students, faculty, staff and visitors at the
University of Minnesota through tasks such as in-class note taking, lab
assistance, and general clerical and administrative work. 
- Upheld the University of Minnesota’s academic integrity standards by
proctoring student exams taken in the Disability Resource Center.
- Maintained exam records using 4D database and processing.
- Ensured state mandated testing accommodations were carried out for
students registered with the Disability Resource Center.

honors.title: Keith Sherin Global Leaders Award
honors.description:
Every June, a group of 15 TRIO SSS and McNair students has an exciting learning opportunity. You will have a chance to explore Salamanca, one of Spain's most spectacular cities, as you immerse yourself in an intensive, month-long study of Spanish language and culture. You'll study with international students at the University of Salamanca and have the option to live with a Spanish family or with other international students in a residence hall. The program is administered by COE and Travel & Education, a program provider that partners with three universities in Spain.

You must be nominated by your TRIO director to apply to this program. Eligible students are TRIO Student Support Services or McNair participants or TRIO pre-college alumni who are in good academic and social standing with their institutions, have at least sophomore status, and have demonstrated leadership ability and potential. Priority will be given to students who have had at least one semester of Spanish or the equivalent. Your college or university must be an Institutional Member of COE for you to participate in this program.
honors.issuer: Issued by Council for Opportunity in Education · Jun 2017

projects.title: Chat Server
projects.description: Developed a chat server and client using multi-threaded processes by reading and writing into named pipes, called FIFOs.

projects.title: Unix Shell
projects.description: Programmed a simple, quasi-command line shell via the forking of parent processes with similar functionality to Linux command line shells.
